headline: The New Course of the Italian Investment Fund Led by Domenico Lombardi
summary: The publicly controlled Italian asset management company wants to grow the Italian private capital market and SMEs. Domenico Lombardi leads the fund, according to The Watcher Post.
why: Publicly controlled investment funds allocate state-backed capital to private companies and can influence the availability of financing for small and medium-sized enterprises.
